facts.fact: ZIMRA commissioned TaRMS on 18 August 2025, the tax administration and revenue system that replaced its SAP-based legacy setup and is in use for filing, payments and refunds.
ZIMRA's release schedule shows TaRMS Release 1 (user management, TIN registration, return filing, payments) went live in December 2023, replacing the legacy SAP system.
